newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex says imported 75,000 BPD in gasoline in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Pemex says imported 75,000 BPD in gasoline in Q2.

text.p: Mexico's state-owned oil company, Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said on Tuesday it had imported 75,000 barrels per day of gasoline and other components in the second quarter of the year.
The value of the imports was $190 million, it said.
Pemex director-general Adrian Lajous said at a press conference that growing domestic demand for gasoline and greater unleaded gasoline consumption had put pressure on the nation's refinery system.
"A deficit of this magnitude calls for the need to increase refining capacity, specifically, for the formulation of gasolines," he said.
He said in the first half of 1997, gasoline sales rose by 3.3 percent in Mexico.
